page.layout: One column of list lines at the top, one indented line below them, then a centred heading "SERIES" lower on the page. No margins with text. Bottom right: a faint digitiser watermark, not transcribed.

main_text.l: Groninga, domus fororum de tert. Reg. Francisc.
Groninga , domus alia fororum de ead. Reg.
Groninga , domus alia fororum de ord. Wilkensi.
Oldeclofter, in die Marne / mon. ord. Præmonst.
Thor Apel in Westerwoldijs , monach. ord. Crucif.

page.notes: The line "in die Marne" is set in black letter, with "Marne" in a decorated capital M; the reading is uncertain. Lines marked as 'ead.' and 'Ciftert' keep the printed spelling. The 'SERIES' heading is spaced capitals with no text beneath it on this page. The digitiser watermark at the bottom right is left out.
